intro_text: Driving sustainable infrastructure, community health research, and long-term capacity building through listening, evidence, and local partnership.

projects.title: Door-To-Door Household Surveys
projects.description: Conducting structured household surveys in Poipet and Phnom Penh to assess healthcare access, health-seeking behaviors, and family financial burdens.

projects.title: School Upgrading & Infrastructure
projects.description: Introducing hygiene soap-making at Love Without Boundaries School, and providing administrative laptops and physical education equipment (volleyball, badminton, soccer) at Tum Nub Kor V School.

projects.title: Koh Dach Island & Groundwork
projects.description: Exploring Koh Dach Island as a potential site for long-term health, education, and community initiatives following our May 2026 recce trip.

future_outlook.title: Future Directions
future_outlook.description: As Project Battambang enters a new phase, the Development Committee will guide initiatives through careful needs assessment, engaging residents, village chiefs, and involving Cambodian counterparts early in survey planning so project direction is guided by evidence and partnership.
